opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers to recruit as many people as possible and directs them to sign up and begin enrolling others, presenting participation as an opportunity they should act on. Its compensation structure ties earnings to multi-level sales teams, including left and right sales legs, organizational business volume, splits, and matching bonuses. The speaker also links paid educational packages to tokens sent to a mining operation, while projecting that the coins’ value could rise to very large amounts. These recruitment instructions, income projections, and promises of financial freedom are presented as reasons to participate, rather than as a warning or investigation, with the closing direction to “get more than one point sign-up start enrolling people.”
